fa_memo.read: Mari Energies runs a highly profitable E&P business, converting roughly 49% of revenue (Rs139.48B) to net income (Rs68.57B), and trades at a trailing P/E of 11.33 versus a forward P/E of 9.23 that implies further earnings growth. Against the model's composite fair value of 547.1, the current 646.82 price sits about 15.4% above, and the valuation methods disagree sharply (relative-PE ~460, earnings-power ~364, Graham ~1161, DDM ~634), so the 'overvalued' verdict rests on a wide spread rather than consensus. The payout ratio near 52% against strong margins suggests the dividend is well covered from earnings, though yield itself is modest. No broker or filing digest was supplied for this name, so the read leans entirely on the numeric feed.
